name: tr_siakam
caption:
IF SIAKAM HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🥋 Tyrogue: keeps fighting even when it loses, to get stronger. Pick 27, then Raptors 905 Finals MVP as a rookie
🐛 Metapod: hardens its shell while it prepares to evolve. 7.3 a night in year two, 16.9 and Most Improved in year three
🎯 Remoraid: superb accuracy, hits moving prey from 300 feet. 32 points on 14-of-17 in Finals Game 1
🌶️ Scovillain: once it goes on a rampage, there's no stopping it. Spicy P, All-Star and All-NBA in 2020
🐴 Mudsdale: hauls 10 tons without rest. Led the NBA in minutes in 2022 and 2023
🌀 Hitmontop: spins on its head while it kicks. The spin got its own McFlurry. Still spinning in Indiana: 22.2 a night through 10 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Pascal Siakam had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF SIAKAM HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Tyrogue. It keeps on fighting, even when it loses, just to get stronger. We took Pascal twenty-seventh. As a rookie, Finals MVP for our G League team.
beats.dlg: KEEPS FIGHTING TO GROW.|ROOKIE: 905 FINALS MVP

beats.vo: Metapod. It hardens its shell and waits, getting ready to evolve. Year two: seven point three a night. Year three: sixteen point nine, Most Improved Player, and a ring.
beats.dlg: IT PREPARES TO EVOLVE.|7.3 PPG, THEN 16.9 + MIP

beats.vo: Remoraid. Superb accuracy: it hits moving prey from three hundred feet. Game one of the Finals: thirty-two points on fourteen of seventeen.
beats.dlg: IT HAS SUPERB ACCURACY.|FINALS G1: 32 ON 14-OF-17

beats.vo: Scovillain. Once it goes on a rampage, there's no stopping it. Spicy P, twenty twenty: his first All-Star game, and All-NBA second team.
beats.dlg: NO STOPPING ITS RAMPAGE.|SPICY P: 2020 ALL-STAR!

beats.vo: Mudsdale. So much stamina it can haul ten tons without rest. Pascal led the whole league in minutes, twice.
beats.dlg: IT NEVER NEEDS TO REST.|LED THE NBA IN MINUTES 2X

beats.vo: And the ace. Hitmontop. It spins on its head while it kicks. That spin got its own McFlurry. Today in Indiana: twenty-two point two through ten games.
beats.dlg: IT ATTACKS WHILE SPINNING.|HIS SPIN GOT A MCFLURRY!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Siakam: selected 27th overall by Toronto in 2016; as a rookie in 2017 led Raptors 905 to the D-League title and was Finals MVP; 2017-18 sophomore year, 2018-19 (year 3) Most Improved Player and NBA champion; nicknamed Spicy P; 2019-20 (2020) first All-Star and All-NBA Second Team; NBA minutes played leader 2022 and 2023 (2X); in game 1 of the 2019 Finals scored 32 points on 14-of-17 shooting; the Siakam Swirl McFlurry was inspired by his iconic spin move; now with the Indiana Pacers
Remoraid can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet; Mudsdale can carry over 10 tons without rest (PokeAPI species flavor text)
